tool_args.rationale: Fit the five parameters numerically in the verified coupled siphon-memory ODE and submit it for fresh confirmation. The trajectory batch provides the recommended minimum of eight observations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired batch supplies eight rows for the specified five-parameter mechanism; no further relevant probe is available.
These present-snapshot mechanisms omit the observed coupled transient memory and gradient-dependent siphon.
The observed gradient values are subcritical, and the specified high-gradient probe is unavailable.
